title: SCRIM-rapport frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a SCRIM vehicle-description note. SCRIM is Storlek, Colour, Registrering, Identifierande kännetecken, Märke — the vehicle form the ATAK 'HV Rapporter' plugin family files alongside an 8S. Applies only to files whose 'typ' is 'SCRIM-rapport'; see FORMAT_SPEC.md §0.

id.description: Stable unique identifier, unique across the whole vault. 'SCRIM-<uuid>' as written by the application.

typ.description: Constant discriminator. A consumer that globs TNR*.md must dispatch on this: 7S, FORS, PEDARS and SCRIM all share the TNR filename prefix.

tnr.description: Report TNR DDHHMM, optionally with a collision suffix _n. Derived from the observation time (STUND), not from when the report reached the application — reports are relayed by hand through the chain of command and can arrive months late.

tidpunkt.description: ISO 8601 local datetime (no timezone offset). The authoritative timestamp of the observation.

signal_tidpunkt.description: ISO 8601 local datetime (no timezone offset) for when the message reached the application. For a relayed report this is the forward time, not the observation.

signal_avsandare_nummer.description: Sender identifier. For a TAK-sourced report this is 'tak:<device uid>'.

regnr.description: Canonical registration from the R field: upper-case, spaces removed. Deliberately NOT restricted to the Swedish plate format — foreign registrations are in scope. Written in the body as a [[link]] in exactly the same canonical form seven_s uses, so a plate seen in a 7S and in a SCRIM resolves to one entity node. Omitted entirely when no plate was observed or the value could not be canonicalised; the raw text is still in the body and the raw block.

plats.description: Free-text place name or grid. Omitted when the report carried no position. Unlike 7S this is NOT required — three of four real samples lacked it.

lat.description: WGS84 latitude in decimal degrees (~5 decimals). Omit entirely if coordinates unknown — do not use null or 0.

lon.description: WGS84 longitude in decimal degrees (~5 decimals). Omit entirely if coordinates unknown.

location.description: Combined coordinate for the Obsidian Map View plugin (FORMAT_SPEC.md §8). REQUIRED when lat/lon are present and must mirror them exactly.

sagesman.description: Reporting call sign. Falls back to the sending device's callsign when the form omitted it. Not required — a real sample lacked it.
